title: The Passage of Patagonia's dry side
author: Juniper Pemberton
blurb: Odile Amberdale, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, has spent ten years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the dry season ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
